description.en: Odontogriphus-inspired shellless flattened oval teaching animal, smooth dorsum, broad continuous foot and restrained marginal gill bands excluding the anterior. Fine radula/gill counts omitted; no modern slug tentacles, shell or dorsal plates.
description.zh: Odontogriphus启发无壳扁椭圆教学动物，光滑背面、连续宽腹足及前端以外克制边缘鳃带。省略微细齿舌和鳃片计数，不加现代蛞蝓触角、壳或背甲。
